title: Coordinate projection is bounded by one
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map the Boolean cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ to the sign set $\{-1,1\}$, let $J$ be a subset of the coordinate set $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The absolute value of the coordinate projection of $f$ onto $J$, evaluated at $x$, is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the coordinates
